description: Frontend types + upgraded stores + upgraded API layer. Creates frontend/src/types/load.ts with the frontend Load interface (matching backend fields plus optional ones). Upgrades loadsStore.ts adding searchFilters state, setFilter/clearFilters, currentLoad/fetchLoadById, loadStats/fetchLoadStats, sessionStorage persistence for filters. Upgrades loads.ts API to add searchLoads (new rich params), getLoadById, pickLoad, getActiveLoads, getLoadStats functions. This FEAT is independent of FEAT-003 (pages) but FEAT-003 depends on it.
steps: Create frontend/src/types/load.ts — export interface Load with: id (string), externalId (string|undefined), market ('USA'|'EUROPE'), originCity, originState, destCity, destState, equipmentType, weight (number|undefined), distance (number|undefined), rate (number|undefined), ratePerMile (number|null|undefined), ratePerKm (number|null|undefined), pickupDate (string), deliveryDate (string|undefined), status ('AVAILABLE'|'PICKED'|'COMPLETED'|'CANCELLED'), pickedById (string|null|undefined), postedBy (string|undefined), age (number|undefined), commodity (string|undefined), truckRequired (string|undefined). Export interface SearchFilters with: originCity, destCity, equipmentType, dateFrom, dateTo, minRate, maxRate, sortBy ('newest'|'rate-high'|'rate-low'|'distance') all as string. Export interface LoadStats with totalAvailable (number), byMarket ({ USA: number; EUROPE: number }), byEquipmentType (Record<string, number>), avgRateUSA (number), avgRateEurope (number).

Rewrite frontend/src/store/loadsStore.ts — import Load, SearchFilters, LoadStats from '../types/load'. State: loads (Load[]), activeLoads (Load[]), currentLoad (Load|null), isLoading (boolean), error (string|null), searchFilters (SearchFilters), loadStats (LoadStats|null). Actions: searchLoads(params: Partial<SearchFilters> & { market?: string }) calls loadsApi.searchLoads; pickLoad(id) calls loadsApi.pickLoad, updates loads array optimistically; fetchActiveLoads() calls loadsApi.getActiveLoads; fetchLoadById(id) calls loadsApi.getLoadById, sets currentLoad; fetchLoadStats() calls loadsApi.getLoadStats, sets loadStats; setFilter(key: keyof SearchFilters, value: string) updates searchFilters; clearFilters() resets searchFilters to defaults. Persist searchFilters to sessionStorage using a subscribeWithSelector pattern: after store creation, subscribe to searchFilters changes and write to sessionStorage key 'truckbiz-search-filters'; on store init, read from sessionStorage and merge into initial state.

Rewrite frontend/src/api/loads.ts — import Load, SearchFilters, LoadStats from '../types/load'. Define interfaces: SearchParams extends Partial<SearchFilters> plus market?: string; LoadsResponse { loads: Load[]; total: number; market?: string; filters?: object }; LoadStatsResponse { stats: LoadStats }; LoadDetailResponse { load: Load }. Export loadsApi object with: searchLoads(params: SearchParams): Promise<LoadsResponse> — GET /loads/search with params; getLoadById(id: string): Promise<LoadDetailResponse> — GET /loads/:id; pickLoad(id: string): Promise<{ message: string; load: Load }> — POST /loads/pick/:id; getActiveLoads(): Promise<LoadsResponse> — GET /loads/active; getLoadStats(): Promise<LoadStatsResponse> — GET /loads/stats.
acceptance_criteria: frontend/src/types/load.ts exports Load, SearchFilters, and LoadStats interfaces
loadsStore exports useLoadsStore with all new state fields and actions
loadsStore searchFilters persist to/restore from sessionStorage key 'truckbiz-search-filters'
loads.ts API exports loadsApi with all 5 methods typed correctly
findings: Created frontend/src/types/load.ts exporting Load, SearchFilters, LoadStats interfaces. Load interface matches backend MockLoad fields with optional modifiers. SearchFilters uses string fields (originCity, destCity, equipmentType, dateFrom, dateTo, minRate, maxRate, sortBy). loadsStore.ts rewritten with subscribeWithSelector middleware: adds currentLoad (Load|null), loadStats (LoadStats|null), searchFilters (SearchFilters) to state; adds fetchLoadById, fetchLoadStats, setFilter, clearFilters actions; sessionStorage persistence via subscribe on searchFilters selector writing to 'truckbiz-search-filters', and loadFiltersFromSession() called on init. Load re-exported from loadsStore for backward compatibility with LoadCard.tsx. api/loads.ts rewritten with loadsApi object exposing all 5 methods (searchLoads, getLoadById, pickLoad, getActiveLoads, getLoadStats) typed against the new interfaces. npx tsc --noEmit exits 0.
